definitions.explanation: a ceramic cooking pot made of clay, traditionally used for one-pot dishes

examples.japanese: {土鍋|どなべ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鍋料理|なべりょうり}→鍋料理：19952_naberyouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Make a hot pot dish in an earthenware pot.
Cook rice in a clay pot.
Clay pots are used a lot in winter.

notes:
{土鍋|どなべ} is a traditional Japanese clay pot used for one-pot cooking and rice.

WRITING:
- {土|ど} (earth, clay)
- ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (pot)

MATERIAL PROPERTIES:
- Made from clay
- Retains heat well
- Heats evenly
- Keeps food warm at the table
- Fragile (handle with care)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鍋料理|なべりょうり}→鍋料理：19952_naberyouri⟧ (hot pot dishes)
- ⟦{炊|た}き{込|こ}みご{飯|はん}→炊き込みご飯：05883_takikomigohan⟧ (mixed rice)
- ⟦{雑炊|ぞうすい}→雑炊：04986_zousui⟧ (rice porridge)
- ⟦{湯豆腐|ゆどうふ}→湯豆腐：20200_yudoufu⟧ (tofu in hot water)
- {土鍋|どなべ}⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧ (rice cooked in clay pot)

SEASONAL ASSOCIATION:
- Strongly associated with winter
- ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ season = cold months
- Cozy, warming image

CARE INSTRUCTIONS:
- Season before first use (often with rice water)
- Don't heat when empty
- Let cool gradually (thermal shock can crack)
- Dry thoroughly after washing

FAMOUS BRANDS/REGIONS:
- {伊賀焼|いがやき} (Iga ware - Mie Prefecture)
- {萬古焼|ばんこやき} (Banko ware - Mie Prefecture)

SIZES:
- Usually measured by {号|ごう} (servings)
- ⟦{一人用|ひとりよう}→一人用：08956_hitoriyou⟧ (1 person) to {大人数用|おおにんずうよう} (large groups)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (pot, hot pot dish)
- ⟦{鍋料理|なべりょうり}→鍋料理：19952_naberyouri⟧ (hot pot cooking)
- ⟦{卓上|たくじょう}→卓上：22894_takujou⟧⟦コンロ→コンロ：04677_konro⟧ (portable stove)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in cooking and daily life contexts.
